name: Bojonegoro

queries.query: Bojonegoro Indonesia cadastral parcel map official GIS BPN
queries.result: Found official ATR/BPN BHUMI and ATLAS portals, the published Bidang Tanah layer, and an official Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Bojonegoro service page. No Bojonegoro-specific anonymous parcel API was identified.

queries.query: Bojonegoro peta bidang tanah kadaster resmi ATR BPN
queries.result: Returned the same official ATR/BPN map and portal documentation plus the local Kantor Pertanahan service page; no separate public local parcel feature service was found.

officialSources.evidence: Live official public map bundle identifies Bidang Tanah as layer umum:Persil, served through configured Geoserver path /bhumigs/umum.
Live public ATLAS catalog returned seven published datasets; no Bojonegoro parcel dataset was listed.
Local service page explicitly identifies cadastral measurement and mapping services and the Bojonegoro land office.
